subject: Track P now uses qualitative item review, with 16 revised Ethan questions
body: The personal questionnaire no longer admits items by Sonnet/Haiku/Luna vote parity. Use trackp review-pairs --file <JSONL> with benefit/cost for both options; agreement.jsonl remains historical. Ethan has 37 audit pair rows, 21 active, 16 new pending; old 21 answers remain raw and only 5 old reviewed questions enter filtered splits. Updated bank wording for future respondents. Full suite passed 833 tests (3 skipped) after integration; commit 7db6a5da is on origin/main. No model calls in this revision.
